title: "Examples"

## Example 1: Quick sentiment proxy

```{r}
positive <- c("good", "great", "helpful")
negative <- c("bad", "poor", "harmful")

score_text <- function(tokens) {
  sum(tokens %in% positive) - sum(tokens %in% negative)
}

sample_tokens <- c("ai", "is", "helpful", "and", "great")
score_text(sample_tokens)
```

## Example 2: Simple n-gram extraction

```{r}
make_bigrams <- function(tokens) {
  if (length(tokens) < 2) return(character())
  paste(tokens[-length(tokens)], tokens[-1])
}

make_bigrams(c("ai", "assisted", "content", "analysis"))
```
